name: ScatterChart
usage: Correlation between two measures (price and sales, size and duration), spotting outliers

props.name: series
props.description:
The series and their points. Use at most 3 series: in a scatter chart any two points can be neighbors, and
only the first 3 chart colors are told apart in every pair.

props.name: xFormat
props.description: How horizontal values are written on the axis, in the tooltip and in the table.

props.name: yFormat
props.description: How vertical values are written on the axis, in the tooltip and in the table.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Name of the horizontal axis: shown under the axis, in the tooltip and as a table header.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Name of the vertical axis: shown along the axis, in the tooltip and as a table header.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Key of the one series the chart is about: it keeps its color and the others use the muted color.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.

props.name: description
props.description: A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit.

props.name: height
props.description:
Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at
this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous
graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives.

props.name: error
props.description: Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range).

props.name: plain
props.description: Without the card (no background, shadow or padding), for charts inside a Panel, a dialog or a drawer.

types.name: ScatterSeries
types.summary: A series of a scatter chart.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the series in the legend, the tooltip and the table; shown as text, never interpreted as HTML.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: Pins the color of the series to a position of the categorical palette (by default its position in the array).

types.name: ValueFormat
types.summary:
How a value is written.
- `'auto'`: in full below 10,000, compact from 10,000 on (1,284 · 12.9K · 4.2M).
- `'number'`: always in full, with grouping separators.
- `'compact'`: always compact.
- `'percent'`: the value is a ratio (0.125 → 12.5%).
- a function: your own formatting (units, currencies).

types.name: ScatterPoint
types.summary: A point of a scatter chart.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Name of the point in the tooltip and the table, such as the item it stands for; shown as text.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
One point per item; `xLabel` and `yLabel` name the axes. The pointer only has to be near a dot: the nearest
point within 16 px shows its tooltip.

examples.name: Series
examples.title: Two series
examples.description:
Up to 3 series: in a scatter chart any two points can be neighbors, and only the first 3 chart colors are told
apart in every pair. For more groups, fold them into "Other" or use small multiples.
